title: $(x) and ${x} mean the same thing
objective: Expand the same variable three ways: with parentheses, with braces, and with the bare $x form.
hint: $() and ${} are interchangeable; pick one and stay with it. The bare form only works for one-character names, which is why it is called bad practice.

steps.description: all three spellings print the same value
steps.stdout:
paren: dude
brace: dude
bare: dude
